'''Card text:'''
Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If aboard Gold 2, also adds 1 to maneuver (and adds 1 to the total of Attack Run at Death Star: Trench.

'''Lore:'''
At the Battle of Yavin, during the attack run on the Death Star trench, he flew Gold 2 as cover for Gold Leader.
